summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Harbor AlphaEdge Mid Cap Growth ETF (AEMG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund actively invests in equity securities of mid-cap growth companies, identified through proprietary growth factor analysis. The portfolio will typically hold between 75 and 150 US stocks. AEMG was launched on Aug 26, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.

holdings.infoBox: AEMG is an equity ETF with a total of 126 individual holdings. The top holdings are Comfort Systems USA stock at 4.57%, Marathon Petroleum at 3.90%, Snowflake at 3.53%, Datadog at 2.70%, and Ameriprise Financial at 2.62%.
